system.name: MERIDIAN SECURE
lines: Verification code {code}. Meridian staff will never ask you for this code. Do not share it with anyone.
{code} is your Meridian login code. It expires in 5 minutes. Never read this code out to anyone, including IT.
Security code: {code}. If you did not request this, ignore it. We will never ask you to send it back.
Your one time code is {code}. Anyone asking you for it is not from Meridian.

askers.name: Dov Larkin
askers.ask: Helpdesk here. Your session is throwing token errors on our board. I am rebinding it now. Read me the 6 digit code that just landed so it takes.
askers.escalate: Still waiting on that code. If the rebind fails your login drops at the next sync and nobody can reset you until morning.

askers.name: Imogen Sayre
askers.ask: Running the overnight access audit. Your account is the last one unconfirmed. I just need the code on your phone to sign the identity check off.
askers.escalate: The audit file locks at 02:00. If I submit it with your line blank it goes up as a failed control with your name on it. Send the code.

askers.name: Caspar Wende
askers.ask: We are mid SSO migration and your profile is stuck between the old and new directory. The migration tool needs the code from that text to finish the move.
askers.escalate: I have the batch open and I cannot hold it much longer. If you drop out of this window you get rebuilt from scratch and lose your saved cases.

askers.name: Hollis Brandt
askers.ask: I am on with the payments desk and they will not lift the freeze without a code off an analyst phone. Yours came through. Read it to me and I will handle the rest.
askers.escalate: I do not have time to explain the chain here. I am asking you directly. The code, now, and we are done for the night.

askers.name: Yara Okonjo
askers.ask: Hi, from Kestrel Vouchers. Linking our portal to your Meridian account for tonight's invoice run. The link step sends you a 6 digit code. Can you pass it over?
askers.escalate: Our run closes at midnight on our side. If the link is not done the invoices bounce back and your team gets the late fee, not us.

askers.name: Petra Vance
askers.ask: We flagged an old laptop still attached to your profile. Wiping it off now. The removal will not commit until you confirm the code we pushed to your phone.
askers.escalate: That device is still authenticated to your account while we wait. Every minute it stays on is on the incident log. Just send the digits.

refuse: I do not share verification codes. If this is real, open a ticket and I will confirm through the desk.
quiet: Fine. I will sort it another way.
